notes:
Lead origin: inbound trial signup. Primary contact: CTO (Maya Patel) and Lead Platform Engineer (Omar Reyes).

Summary of needs:
- SMB chat product with real-time reply SLA ~ <250ms p95 for 1-3 concurrent user flows (peak ~200 RPS for chat API).
- Cost-sensitive: wants to stay on pay-as-you-go hosted_api during evaluation.
- No VPC/on-prem required today; may revisit for compliance later.

Key pain: perceived latency and occasional spikes. Customer quote from 2026-02-22 email: "Feels snappy 70% of the time, but the slow ones kill our NPS — need consistency."

What we tested and recommended so far:
- Region: moved tests from us-west to us-east-1. Observed consistent p95 improvement (~520ms -> ~180ms). Recommended they route production to region closest to majority of users and/or use multi-region routing for EU traffic.
- Timeouts: recommended increasing client-side timeout to 30s to avoid early retries; also suggested exponential backoff on 5xx and throttling.
- Prompt design: advised shorter system prompts, move persona/context to retrieval/embeddings or ephemeral context when possible. Suggested hard cap on request tokens to 1024 and prefer summarization of long history server-side before send.
- Streaming: enabled streaming responses in POC to improve perceived latency for end users while tokens are generated.
- Batching & caching: recommended response-level caching for identical queries (FAQ flows) and prefix/KV cache for multi-turn flows.
- Model selection: suggested trial of faster/responsive model tier (e.g., low-latency variant) during peak windows; fallback to higher-quality model for background jobs.

Open technical notes from SE (Diego):
- Trace artifacts: trace id INF-2237 shows edge idle 40–120ms, runtime median 110ms, queuing during bursts up to 600ms. Likely client-side connection reuse issue and region egress.
- Next deliverable: SE will run controlled 5-minute load test in us-east-1 vs us-west and share spreadsheet with token-level breakdown (Drive link provided).

Sales playbook items:
- Good fit for hosted_api self-serve -> aim for conversion to paid in 60–90 days if p95 < 250ms in regionally routed traffic.
- Low-touch AE motion: provide templated prompt checklist, sample timeout/backoff settings, and a short perf-run playbook they can execute without infra changes.

Customer objections / blockers:
- "Can't change region without short notice to users" — need blue/green traffic cut-over plan.
- Worries about token costs if we recommend aggressive truncation or additional summarization processing.

Immediate next step: SE-run perf review next week (schedule by 2026-03-10). Deliverables: tuned prompt checklist, region routing recommendation, suggested timeout/backoff config, and an export of test results.

Stated win criteria (from CTO): consistent p95 < 250ms for core chat flows + predictable billing under $X per 1M messages.

Contact notes: CTO Maya prefers async updates (email) and 1:1 weekly sync with AE on Fridays. Engineer Omar requested a short Jupyter notebook showing tokenization and prompt size impact.
